title: Pipe Dream
story: The final hands-on challenge is a three-stage assembly line followed by an interrogator that refuses interactive keyboard input.
description:
1. Assembly Line: Connect `/challenge/stage1`, `/challenge/stage2`, and `/challenge/stage3` in a single pipeline so `stage3` outputs your secret passphrase.
2. The Interrogator: Feed that exact passphrase into `/challenge/interrogator`'s standard input (`stdin`) without typing it interactively to receive your flag.
hints: Connect the output of `stage1` to `stage2`, and `stage2` to `stage3` using pipes.
Send that passphrase into `/challenge/interrogator` via a pipe or input file redirection.
